items.title: Eli Lilly outlays $3.35bn for secretive drug discovery pact with China’s InnoCare
items.summary: InnoCare, which already has three approved therapies, describes itself as a biopharma focusing on cancer and autoimmune disease treatments.

items.title: Australia starts investigation into OpenAI Medicare breach
items.summary: Amid this probe, experts point to the importance of airtight AI governance when implementing the technology in high-risk contexts.

items.title: Podcast: How Sandoz plans to harness its “golden decade”
items.summary: Sandoz’s chief commercial officer discusses the company’s ambitions plans to have a biosimilar-driven growth engine by 2040.

items.title: Enveda nabs $311m to progress nature-derived drug pipeline
items.summary: The cash will primarily fund Enveda’s continued development of three clinical-stage assets for inflammatory and metabolic disorders.

items.title: Genialis and Inventia to enhance pancreatic cancer treatment testing
items.summary: Genialis and Inventia Life Science have partnered to enhance pancreatic cancer treatment testing and match them to the patients who are likely to benefit.
